S1.goal: Exercise capture, insertion, startup and desktop state transitions in isolated profiles
S1.expected: Each drivable scenario passes; no owned process leaks; unsupported installed-session/model cases remain explicit skips

S2.goal: Open every settings and onboarding route and observe persisted writes
S2.expected: All supported GUI routes show the expected state and writes match backend configuration
limits: The pack pins supplemental Cua steps. Preserve its full verdict and separately report mandatory AT-SPI coverage; no driver installation or update is authorized.

S3.goal: Search, rerun, export and delete seeded history
S3.expected: UI rows, search hits and exported files match the seeded backend; failure and unavailable states remain visible

S4.goal: Import, recover, cancel, export and rename seeded meetings
S4.expected: Actions update the same backend identities and notes, final export content matches, invalid media refuses, cancellation remains terminal

S5.goal: Exercise live meeting search and explicit notes export overrides
commands: temporary notes_export_probe using dettivo_qa runner and AT-SPI
S5.expected: Search results match the backend and clear restores rows; nonempty, empty and whitespace editor values override stored notes in JSON exports
error_paths: empty/whitespace notes after another client changes stored notes

S6.goal: Observe daemon reconnect, live theme application and release app timing
S6.expected: Reconnection refreshes the UI; first frame remains under 300ms and theme application under 100ms

S7.goal: Compare every current visual render and reject independent regression plants
commands: visual design-system builtin-dark 1x canaries for colour/type/spacing
S7.expected: No baseline approval or tolerance increase; preserve every matrix failure; distinguish actual pixel changes from stricter detection
limits: Intentional import composition and existing fn-38 approvals remain human-owned

S8.goal: Measure five fresh native Wayland release launches on Thor
S8.expected: Each launch after five continuously observed idle seconds meets RSS<=262144KiB and Anonymous<=98304KiB; first frame<300ms; PSS reported uncapped
error_paths: missing/unreadable/malformed metrics or early exit cannot pass
limits: No renderer, scale, threshold or host configuration changes

S9.goal: Measure five fresh Xvfb release launches as secondary reference
S9.expected: Same exact per-launch memory/startup requirements as S8; this cannot replace native evidence
error_paths: unsupported platform or missing release binaries fails or blocks

S10.goal: Exercise native Qt component keyboard/accessibility behavior and Omarchy shell fixtures
S10.expected: Keyboard/accessibility actions execute once, bindings persist, error/reconnect actions show the expected fixture state
limits: Component/shell-shim evidence; no installed personal Omarchy integration claim
